title: 第25章 玄幻世界照样开挂第26章 练武药浴
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 在王昭昭的讲述中，一个全新的世界在林夜脑海中展开。
习武之人，统称为武者。
武者境界，从九品到一品，一品之上为先天，先天之上是大宗师。
九品熬练气血，施展劲力，精气旺盛如狼烟，一拳至少一牛之力。
像他之前遇到的狼王，就凭武者施展武学，一招就可轰杀。
到了八品，化劲为气，丹田出现内力，能如武侠小说一般内力外放。
七品内力贯通，一身内力连绵不绝，提气便可跃起三丈。
六品化气为罡，身体堪比铜皮铁骨，刀枪不入。
在往上的境界如何，王昭昭并不清楚。
她只知道五品光凭威压都能解决掉九品武者。
到了先天，就已经脱离了凡人的范畴。
大宗师更是恐怖如斯。
不但增寿千载，招手便能催山覆海，弹指便能灭一座城。
整个世界，也不过只有四尊大宗师，无一不是彪炳千古的传奇人物。
而她爷爷王烈，目前是六品武者。
别说是曲县，就是整个太岳俯，都是排得上号的高手。
林夜听着入迷，同时也暗暗咋舌。
他的世界观目前为止已经经历了两次重塑。
第一次是知道这个世界有妖怪，第二次便是听闻了武者之境。
此时他终于意识到，自己所在的是一方真正的玄幻世界。
而且还是一个，修炼之法和武学完全被垄断的世界。
像林夜家这种占绝大多数的农民，连了解的资格都没有。
成为武者很难，从小打基本功，就要花费至少上千两银子。
想到九品武者境，花费的不止是数千两银子，还必须有资质才行。
资质一般的人，练个十年八载的，才能入九品。
王昭昭目前十七岁，已经入了八品，算是资质不错的。
打开了新世界的大门，林夜心中满是期待和兴奋。
他想赶紧试试，金手指能不能作用在修炼上。
跟在王昭昭身后，林夜认识了其他几个武馆弟子。
今日在武馆的，加上王昭昭一共四个，除此之外还有十个弟子，分散在周边县城。
这些弟子，最小的十二岁，最大的已经四十岁。
他们身份非富即贵，但对林夜的态度还算不错。
其中让林夜印象最深刻的，便是年过四十的大师兄邹文元。

In Wang Zhaozhao's narration, a whole new world unfolded in Lin Ye's mind.
People who practice martial arts are collectively called martial artists.
The realm of warriors ranges from the ninth level to the first level. Those above the first level are innate, and those above innate are great masters.
The ninth level trains Qi and blood and exerts strength. The energy is as strong as smoke, and a punch is at least as powerful as an ox.
Like the Wolf King he met before, the warrior could kill him with just one move using his martial arts skills.
At the eighth level, the energy is transformed into Qi, and internal energy appears in the Dantian, which can be released like a martial arts novel.
The internal energy of the seventh level is penetrated, and the internal energy of the whole body is continuous. You can jump up to three feet with just one breath.
The sixth level transforms Qi into Gang, and the body is comparable to copper skin and iron bones, and is invulnerable.
Wang Zhaozhao doesn't know what the higher realm is like.
She only knew that a fifth-grade warrior could defeat a ninth-grade warrior with just coercion.
When it comes to innateness, it has already broken away from the realm of mortals.
The Grand Master is even more terrifying.
Not only can one's life be extended to a thousand years, but a wave of the hand can cause mountains and seas to overturn, and a city can be destroyed with a snap of the fingers.
There are only four great masters in the entire world, and all of them are legendary figures who will shine through the ages.
And her grandfather, Wang Lie, is currently a sixth-grade warrior.
Not to mention Qu County, the entire Taiyuefu are all top-ranked masters.
Lin Ye listened in fascination and was secretly speechless at the same time.
His worldview has been reshaped twice so far.
The first time was when I learned that there were monsters in this world, and the second time was when I heard about the realm of warriors.
At this time, he finally realized that he was in a real fantasy world.
Moreover, it is a world where cultivation methods and martial arts are completely monopolized.
The vast majority of farmers like Lin Yejia are not even qualified to understand.
It is very difficult to become a warrior. You have to spend at least a thousand taels of silver to develop basic skills since childhood.
Thinking about the ninth-grade warrior realm, it costs more than thousands of taels of silver, and one must also be qualified.
People with average qualifications can only reach the ninth level after practicing for ten or eight years.
Wang Zhaozhao is currently seventeen years old and has already entered the eighth level. He is considered to have good qualifications.
Opening the door to a new world, Lin Ye was filled with anticipation and excitement.
He wanted to try quickly to see if the golden finger could be used in cultivation.
Following Wang Zhaozhao, Lin Ye met several other martial arts disciples.
There are four people in the martial arts hall today, including Wang Zhaozhao. In addition, there are ten disciples scattered in surrounding counties.
The youngest of these disciples is twelve years old, and the oldest is forty years old.
They were either rich or noble, but their attitude towards Lin Ye was pretty good.
Among them, the one who impressed Lin Ye the most was his senior brother Zou Wenyuan, who was over forty years old.
